model.description: Glob the disk's model matches, such as `Samsung SSD 870*`.

path.description: Path of the disk below /dev, such as /dev/disk/by-id/…; excludes the selector keys.

size.description: Comparison the disk's size meets, such as `>= 1T`.

disk.description: Disk the volume occupies on its own; null places it on the system disk.

mode.description: Overrides the node's encryption mode for this volume.

format.description: File system of the volume; null leaves a raw block device.

mountPoint.description: Where the volume is mounted; null leaves it unmounted.

repart.description: Extra repart.d keys of the volume's partition. Type, Label, Encrypt, Format, SizeMinBytes, SizeMaxBytes and MountPoint come from the typed options.

size.description: Size of the volume; null fills the remaining space on its disk.
